proposal.reason: Primary change is in GIN-specific RDMA backends (GDAKI and GIN_IB_PROXY) to rotate/reset QP LAG TX-port affinity across peers/contexts with capability-gated fallback behavior, so `gin` is the main review module. `network` is additionally needed because shared MLX5 direct-verbs wrapper/symbol surfaces and proxy-side QP LAG query/modify handling were extended, which affects network transport/proxy connection behavior beyond a purely local refactor.
